description: Canonical public-record resolver configuration for Alex Ford Adventures. Evidence-source inventory and precedence live in a dedicated evidence manifest and compile into one stable record layer before matches, tombstones and explicit overrides are applied. Official race-result fields remain authoritative when verified; Strava remains GPS evidence and fallback.

chicago-marathon-virtual-2020.matchSource: Strava export + user authorization to publish GPS route

colfax-marathon-2025.resultSource: Denver Colfax Marathon official race-results archive
colfax-marathon-2025.matchSource: Original alexlford.com marathon inventory + user Colfax Marathon medal + official 2025 marathon weekend archive + exact-date Strava GPS

bolderboulder-2025.matchSource: Strava export + user confirmation that the 2025 BOLDERBoulder was completed virtually in Denver after rain changed the in-person plan
bolderboulder-2025.note: Rain on the morning of the 2025 BOLDERBoulder changed the plan. Alex slept in and completed the 10K virtually later that day in Denver; the published route is the actual 887-point Denver GPS track, not the Boulder race course.

bolderboulder-series-story.matchSource: Official BOLDERBoulder results + Strava GPS + user confirmation
bolderboulder-series-story.note: Four consecutive BOLDERBoulder 10K completions from 2022 through 2025: in person in Boulder from 2022 through 2024, then virtually in Denver in 2025 after rain changed the Memorial Day plan.
